panels.description: Observed state ratio inside the selected time range; not vendor OEE.

panels.title: OPERATIONAL STATE HISTORY
panels.description: Adaptive status sampling over the selected time range.

targets.rawSql:
WITH sampled AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (date_bin('$__interval'::interval,event_time,TIMESTAMPTZ '1970-01-01'))
    date_bin('$__interval'::interval,event_time,TIMESTAMPTZ '1970-01-01') AS time,equipment_id,event_type
  FROM public.machine_event
  WHERE equipment_id=${focus_machine:sqlstring} AND message_type='status' AND $__timeFilter(event_time)
  ORDER BY date_bin('$__interval'::interval,event_time,TIMESTAMPTZ '1970-01-01'),event_time DESC,id DESC
)
SELECT time,equipment_id AS metric,CASE WHEN event_type='RUN' THEN 4 WHEN event_type='STOP' THEN 3 ELSE 5 END AS value FROM sampled ORDER BY time

panels.title: DAILY OBSERVED REPORT
panels.description: Daily counts derived only from machine_event evidence.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT (event_time AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Bangkok')::DATE AS "Date (Asia/Bangkok)",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE message_type='status' AND event_type='RUN') AS "RUN Records",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE message_type='status' AND event_type='STOP') AS "STOP Records",
  SUM(CASE WHEN event_code='0201' AND event_message ~* 'Run Hits\s*:' THEN (regexp_match(event_message,'Run Hits\s*:\s*([0-9]+)','i'))[1]::INTEGER ELSE 0 END) AS "Reported Run Hits",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE event_type='PROGRAM_LOAD') AS "Program Loads",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE event_code='0119') AS "Tool-Life Events",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE message_type='alarm' AND level='E') AS "Historical Errors"
FROM public.machine_event WHERE equipment_id=${focus_machine:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter(event_time)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 DESC

panels.title: EVENT / TOOL / ERROR EVIDENCE
panels.description: Raw decoded evidence for investigation, capped by the row-limit setting.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT event_time AS "Time",message_type AS "Type",event_type AS "Event",event_code AS "Code",event_message AS "Message",level AS "Level",decode_status AS "Decode",decoder_version AS "Decoder"
FROM public.machine_event WHERE equipment_id=${focus_machine:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter(event_time)
  AND (${event_filter:sqlstring}='All' OR message_type=${event_filter:sqlstring})
ORDER BY event_time DESC,id DESC LIMIT ${raw_limit:raw}
